headline: Russian troops breach Ukrainian line near Sloviansk, threatening last Donetsk stronghold
subheadline: Russian forces advanced within four kilometers of Sloviansk and pierced the first defensive line between Sloviansk and Kramatorsk, sparking street fighting in Nikolayevka and Nikanorovka
lede: IDF eliminated Hamas commander Ismail Muhammad Ibrahim Barim, who held three Israeli hostages in a southern Gaza tunnel, while striking Hezbollah infrastructure in Nabatieh after drone attacks on Ali al‑Tahar ridge. In the Ukraine‑Russia war, Russian troops advanced to within four kilometers of Sloviansk and breached the first defensive line between Sloviansk and Kramatorsk, with street fighting reported in Nikolayevka and Nikanorovka. Overnight Russian drone and missile strikes hit Kyiv, Odesa, Zaporizhzhia, Kharkiv and Sumy, destroying the Kherson thermal power plant and killing at least one civilian. The IDF Chief of Staff ordered heightened readiness of another brigade ahead of the holiday period amid ongoing ceasefire violations and budget constraints.

sections.title: Russian Breakthrough Near Sloviansk Threatens Donetsk Stronghold
sections.body: Russian troops advanced to within four kilometers of Sloviansk and pierced the first defensive line between Sloviansk and Kramatorsk, sparking street fighting in Nikolayevka and Nikanorovka. Overnight Russian drone and missile strikes hit Kyiv, Odesa, Zaporizhzhia, Kharkiv and Sumy, killing at least one civilian and wounding dozens, while four aerial bombs destroyed the Kherson thermal power plant, cutting heating for the city. Russian air defenses claimed 39 Ukrainian UAVs shot down over Russian regions and the Black and Azov seas, and Ukrainian drones struck an Ozon warehouse in Bashkortostan and a Turkish vessel in the Black Sea, injuring five crew members.

sections.title: IDF Eliminates Hamas Commander, Strikes Hezbollah
sections.body: IDF eliminated Hamas commander Ismail Muhammad Ibrahim Barim, who was holding hostages Idan Alexander, Matan Zenguok and Avraham Mengistu in a southern Gaza tunnel. Hezbollah launched two explosive drones at IDF forces on the Ali al‑Tahar ridge, prompting IDF strikes on weapons storage warehouses in Nabatieh. Two additional Hamas commanders, Bilal Ibrahim Saleh Raqi'i in Shati camp and Azzam Rifaat Abd Abadalla in Khan Younis, were eliminated for ceasefire violations. Meanwhile, an attack in western Gaza City killed one Israeli, Nitzan Shapira, and wounded several others, and the IDF Chief of Staff ordered heightened readiness of another brigade ahead of the holiday period.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The surge in Hezbollah drone attacks and subsequent IDF strikes on Nabatieh underscores an escalating northern front, while the elimination of a Hamas hostage‑holding commander highlights Israel's enforcement of ceasefire terms amid stalled negotiations. Russian advances near Sloviansk and extensive drone‑missile campaigns across Ukraine demonstrate a shift toward deep‑strike operations aimed at crippling civilian infrastructure, notably the destruction of the Kherson thermal plant. Ukrainian cross‑border strikes on Russian logistics and a Turkish vessel signal expanding operational reach but raise the risk of broader regional escalation.
